scope: Extend existing pipeline datasets to a target total without replacing completed drawings

growthControls: Exclude retained category/key identities and source hashes
Keep completed artifacts across processing revisions
Record each processing revision without relabeling older records
Retain failures as selected slots and retry without duplicate identities
Never delete records when lowering the target

qualification: Growth is enabled for pipeline workspaces. Standalone baseline convert/sample retain their existing behavior. Existing completed drawings are preserved rather than reinterpreted; use a separate output to compare processing changes. Raw-input and derived-copy workspace modes remain distinct. User drawings were inspected but not extended during verification.
